map.平均赔付强度（件均赔款）= 赔款总额 ÷ 索赔件数（主公式）；另给衍生参考卡：按: Average claim severity (average claim per case) = total claims ÷ number of claims (main formula); additional derived cards: per-exposure apportionment = severity ÷ max(number of claims, 10⁻⁹), claims per unit of payment = number of claims ÷ max(total, 10⁻¹²), average payment percentage = severity × 100. Validation: total and number of claims must be non-empty numeric values. Rule: with a fixed total, more claims mean lower average severity; the three derived cards are only for comparison, and the main formula governs practice.
